description.value: Harold's Kitchen & Bar is a full-service restaurant and bar inside the Sheraton Vancouver Airport Hotel in Richmond, named in tribute to Harold Cross — a beloved daily regular who lunched there for over 30 years until his passing at age 98 in 2020. Executive Chef Tim Vu, with over 20 years at the hotel, leads a kitchen blending classic comfort food with West Coast and Mediterranean-Asian influences. The restaurant is a genuine local institution that hosts community events tied to Richmond's cultural calendar, including Lunar New Year celebrations and seasonal buffets.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 89m; rack at 97m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM address and supplies a phone number absent from OSM; active 2026 event listings confirm the business is open. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or water refill appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those criteria remain null. The menu page explicitly labels items as V, VG, GF, and GFA, directly confirming vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options.
concerns: OSM name is 'Harold's' but the website consistently uses 'Harold's Kitchen & Bar' as the full business name.
OSM cuisine tag is 'buffet' but the restaurant primarily offers full à la carte service across multiple menus; buffet is one option among many.
No phone number in OSM; phone (604) 233-3968 sourced from website only.
Restaurant is located inside the Sheraton Vancouver Airport Hotel — bike access and parking may be constrained by hotel property layout or policies.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service restaurant with strong dietary options, but located inside an airport hotel with no evidence of bike parking or cyclist-facing amenities; on-site verification is needed to assess cycling accessibility.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels items as V (Vegetarian), VG (Vegan), DF (Dairy-Free), GF (Gluten-Free), and GFA (Gluten-Free upon request); examples include Vegetarian Hash (V), Egg White Frittata (DF, GFA), Oatmeal (VG), and Vegetarian Omelet (V, GFA)
